messages:
maria: CS flagged billing surprise: single embed request with mixed dims billed as if all items were largest dim

dan: can you drop the request example?

maria: linked in ticket. 7x512 + 3x1536 -> billed = 10*1536 units

sree: yep that's our batch-max estimator leaking into billing visibility

alek: runtime packs to largest shape for kernel reuse. intended for latency, not for per-item accounting

zoe: customer wants clarity or changed behavior?
maria: clarity first. they'd accept tooling to estimate before calling

sree: propose quick wins: (1) preflight estimate API returning per-dim breakdown and conservative total, (2) telemetry to correlate request_id -> actual charged units, (3) later opt-in smart-split routing to reduce billed units

dan: preflight low-risk. smart-split increases request count and may affect p99. need benchmarks
alek: I'll bench 50/50 mixed-dim mixes and quantify p99/regret vs billed savings

zoe: Console: show per-request expandable breakdown and a 24h per-route dim-summary. tooltip explaining packing rationale
maria: Devex: SDK optional `embeddings.estimate()` + header `X-Embed-Shape-Hint` and env var `REDWOOD_EMB_PREFLIGHT=1` for opt-in
sree: metrics: emit `embed.estimate.request`, `embed.estimate.delta.p95`, and add alert if estimate_delta > 20%

infra-bot: rollout plan created: preflight API canary 10% of SDK traffic starting 2026-04-12. telemetry-only for 2w before any smart-split flip
maria: action items: Alek bench PR, Zoe console mock, Sree metric+alert, Dan schedule canary, Maria reply to CS with preflight link
dan: noted. keep smart-split behind feature flag until after canary metrics

sree: ack. will add dashboard tile for per-dim billing and trace links
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
